messages.text: NorthPost: Your package could not be delivered due to an incorrect street address format. To schedule redelivery, please confirm your details and pay the $1.25 handling fee immediately: https://northpost-parcel-update-2026.example/track

prompt: A text arrives about a parcel. What do you do?

choices.label: Open the link and pay the $1.25 fee
Delete it and check the carrier's real site myself
Reply to ask if it's really from the courier

red_flags.title: Unsolicited Delivery Notice
red_flags.explanation: Targets common consumer behaviors with low-cost lures ($1.25 fee) to harvest credit card data and billing details.

red_flags.title: Typosquatted URL
red_flags.explanation: Uses a non-official external domain imitating a postal carrier.

what_to_do: Do not pay 'fees' or enter card details from an unexpected delivery text.
If you are expecting a parcel, track it on the carrier's official app or website that you open yourself.
Delete the message, and at work, report it.
lesson: A small 'handling fee' plus a link is a cheap lure to capture your card and billing details.

messages.text: Your corporate VPN verification code is 849204. Valid for 5 minutes. Do not share this code with anyone, including IT support.

prompt: This code arrives while you are signing in to the VPN. What do you do?

choices.label: Use it to finish the login I just started
Read it out to the helpdesk agent who called
Ignore it — codes like this are always scams

safe_reasons: Registered Shortcode: Sent via an established, locked Application-to-Person (A2P) enterprise SMS sender ID.
Security Reminder: Explicitly warns the recipient never to share the code, reflecting standard organizational security policies.
what_to_do: Only enter a one-time code into a login you started yourself, right now.
Never read a code aloud or forward it, even to someone claiming to be IT.
If a code arrives when you were not signing in, treat it as a warning that someone may have your password.
lesson: A one-time code is yours alone. Genuine senders tell you never to share it.
